note: Polk County campground on Cross Lake NE of Fosston, run with a camp host; boat access, docks (slips leased) and a picnic shelter. Many hookup sites are let by the season. --Claude
summary: County page, site map, rules and emergency plan read: 30 sites (20 electric, 10 primitive), water at hookup sites, showers, dump, daily $26.84 + $10.74 electric = $37.58, seasonal rates posted, camp-host phone. No season or booking channel stated. Not waterfront kept. Long-stay character flagged (nightly share unknown).
flags: LONG-STAY (local campground, five tests apply if the reviewer reads it as mostly seasonal): the county posts both a daily rate ('Camping Fee $26.84 per day') and season rates for both hookup types; the rules read seasonal ('Jet Skis are only allowed on leased dock slips', 'Air conditioners must be turned off when you leave for an extended period of time', 'Wood must be stacked neatly within the confines of the lot'). The nightly share is not published; Esri imagery shows ~10 RVs, several with sheds/decks. Daily rate posted, so it reads as a real public campground with a seasonal majority possible; no wording discouraging nightly guests was found.
SITES: count 37 -> 30 (county page: '30 camp sites (20 with electric and 10 primitive)'; the old '15 RV + 22 tent' was from listings).
HOOKUPS: amperage not published; electric left unset. Sewer is on most hookup sites per the 2016 map but the page does not say which are nightly, so sewer left unset.
BOOKING / SEASON: no reservation channel or season dates on any county page; the only contact is the camp host's cell. Left unset.
FACILITIES: flush_toilets (stored, derived) not confirmed: the page says only 'Public restrooms'. Left as is.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the nearest pads (13, 15 and the host site by the office, about 47.6266,-95.6380) sit ~30-40 m from Cross Lake behind a continuous band of shoreline trees; the open lakeside ground is the boat access, docks and picnic area, not sites.
PHONE 218-686-0975 is the camp host's cell per the county's Emergency Action Plan; confirmed. Polk County Highway Office 218-281-3952 is the office line if a landline is preferred.
PIN 47.6273,-95.6369 is on the boat-access lot ~60-90 m east of the site loops; under 250 m, no move.
